record.reason: Publisher material identifies a gastrointestinal endoscopy image-restoration model that adaptively selects visual tokens and fuses frequency-domain features, evaluated on image-restoration datasets. Its reported application is medical image super-resolution/denoising, not an LLM or language-model serving workload. The accessible publisher text notes failure on severely blurred images and instrument deformation.
record.title: A self-adaptive top token transformer for gastrointestinal endoscopy image restoration
